headline: Grendene Reports Q3 Adjusted Net Profit Down 18.2%
summary: Grendene reported an adjusted net profit of R$150.984 million for the third quarter, an 18.2% decrease year-over-year, while net revenue fell 2.4% to R$742.131 million.
why: Earnings reports from major manufacturers provide insight into consumer spending trends, cost pressures, and top-line performance in the retail manufacturing sector.

impacts.name: Grendene
impacts.why: Lower quarterly profit and revenue indicate contraction in earnings performance.
